arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Corrected comprehensive test for R1
print('=== Final R1 Tests ===')
print()

test_cases = [
    ('{val}', 'hello\\n', 'Basic named field'),
    ('{}', 'world\\n', 'Basic anonymous field'),
    ('{val:d}', '42\\n', 'Typed digit field'),
    ('{0:d}', '99\\n', 'Digit positional field'),
    ('prefix {} suffix', 'prefix data suffix\\n', 'Text around field'),
    ('line1\\nline2', 'line1\\nline2', 'Pattern with internal newline (exact)'),
    ('{}\\n{}', 'a\\nb', 'Two fields with separator'),
    ('text {:d}\\n', 'text 42\\n', 'Literal text with typed field and newline'),
]

all_pass = True
for pattern, input_str, desc in test_cases:
    try:
        r = parse.parse(pattern, input_str)
        if r is None:
            print(f'FAIL: {desc}')
            print(f'      Pattern: {repr(pattern)}, Input: {repr(input_str)}')
            all_pass = False
        else:
            print(f'PASS: {desc} -> {r.fixed or r.named}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'ERROR: {desc} - {e}')
        all_pass = False

print()
if all_pass:
    print('All R1 tests passed!')
else:
    print('Some R1 tests failed!')
"
